# Tanmay Mahajan — Software Engineer, AI & Full-Stack Developer

Tanmay Mahajan is a software engineer and AI / full-stack developer based in Mumbai, India. Tanmay is studying B.E. Computer Engineering at Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering (Fr. CRCE, 2024 – 2028), works as a Full Stack Developer Intern at THE xDEVS, and is Executive Producer of TEDxCRCE.

Tanmay builds AI products end to end: financial data platforms, risk-aware systems and tooling for AI agents. Most of them started at hackathons, including Nexus360, which won 1st place at CODEISSANCE 2026 (TSEC Codestorm).

Website: https://tanmay.devs.surf/ · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/tanmay-mahajan-220ab826b/ · GitHub: https://github.com/TanmayMahajan26 · Email: tanmay261006@gmail.com

## Projects

### Nexus360 — AI identity resolution and Customer 360 platform

1st Place · CODEISSANCE 2026. Category: AI · Data platform. Built: CODEISSANCE 2026, TSEC Codestorm. Result: 1st Place — Industry domain, Customer 360 problem statement.

- Built a 7-stage matching pipeline to unify customer records across Equity, Mutual Funds, Insurance, Loans and Wealth systems.
- Implemented conflict detection with explainable matches and an interactive identity graph.
- Added AI verification for high-risk cases, a what-if threshold simulator, audit trails and RBAC.

Links: [Live demo](https://codeissance-26-skill-issue.vercel.app/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/TanmayMahajan26/CODEISSANCE_26_Skill-Issue)
Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/nexus360/

### SYNAPSE — Compiler and observability platform for AI agent workflows

3.2x faster · 31% cheaper. Category: AI infrastructure · Compilers. Stack: Zero-dependency Python, Groq models. Result: 3.2x lower latency and 31% lower cost with identical outputs.

- Built a zero-dependency Python compiler that turns AI agent workflows into dependency-aware graphs.
- Applied parallelization, caching and model routing, each checked by structural validation and 123 automated tests.
- Cut latency 3.2x and cost 31% with identical outputs on real Groq models.
- Added a safety guard so side-effecting steps are never cached, merged or reordered.

Links: [Watch the demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1quUxlf0JabOfA2Tj0aRxoeCU1s2ZCtsP/view?usp=sharing) · [GitHub](https://github.com/TanmayMahajan26/Synapse)
Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/synapse/

### WellSync AI — Full-stack health platform with live AI agents

Top 4 Finalist · IIT Hyderabad. Category: Health · Multi-agent AI. Built: IIT Hyderabad AI Hackathon. Result: Top 4 Finalist — selected for the offline final round.

- Built using APIs with 5 live agents working together.
- Developed a dedicated Android application alongside the web platform.
- Implemented real-time health tracking on a scalable backend architecture.

Links: [Live demo](https://wellsync-ai.vercel.app/)
Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/wellsync/

### JusticeGrid — AI legal intelligence for India’s undertrial prisoner crisis

Finalist · SPIT Airavat 3.0. Category: Legal tech · NLP. Stack: Next.js 14, FastAPI, Gemini 2.0 Flash. Result: Finalist — Sardar Patel Institute of Technology Airavat 3.0.

- Built a paralegal dashboard that surfaces high-priority undertrial cases.
- Wrote an S.479 BNSS eligibility engine to flag who may qualify for release.
- Combined multilingual NLP with adjournment-prediction ML.

Links: [Live demo](https://skill-issue-airavat-3-0.vercel.app/)
Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/justicegrid/

### Zenthera — High-speed antimicrobial resistance prediction pipeline

Published paper. Category: Bioinformatics · Machine learning. Method: k-mer based genomic analysis + ML. Result: Published in IJRIAS.

- Built a high-speed antimicrobial resistance (AMR) prediction pipeline using k-mer based genomic analysis and machine learning.
- Trained and evaluated on 148,000+ bacterial genome records, achieving 92.4% accuracy.

Links: [Live demo](http://zenthera-ml.onrender.com/) · [Read the paper](https://rsisinternational.org/journals/ijrias/view/zenthera-a-high-speed-antimicrobial-resistance-prediction-pipeline-using-k-mer-analysis-and-tree-based-ensembles)
Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/zenthera/

### FRA Tracker — Forest Rights Act monitoring system (Smart India Hackathon)

SIH. Category: GovTech · WebGIS. Built: Smart India Hackathon. Coverage: Madhya Pradesh, Tripura, Odisha, Telangana.

- Developed an AI-powered FRA Atlas for Forest Rights Act data.
- Built a WebGIS-based Decision Support System (DSS) for integrated monitoring of FRA implementation across four states.

Page: https://tanmay.devs.surf/projects/fra-tracker/
